The Poison:
While elite events do exist, using them to justify destroying a massive public educational and artistic resource is a classic burn-it-all-down maneuver.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The article commits a Metaphysical error (WHO) by claiming the public benefits from losing a cultural center, hiding a political branding grab behind populist pretexts.

Social Physics Analysis:
The actors execute a Smart Selfish Maneuver. They manufacture a crisis of "decadence" to justify destroying a public asset, projecting their own desire for political branding control onto the institution.

The Trajectory: The Path of Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. This active contraction of civic space leaves everyone poorer.

The Unavoidable Truth: Public cultural spaces belong to all citizens, not just the elites who attend them.
The Unavoidable Lie: Tearing down a national memorial helps the working class.
